From 7cb9a23d7ae40a702577d3d8bacb7026f04ac2a9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Florian Westphal <fw@strlen.de>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 21:32:00 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] netfilter: nf_tables: always walk all pending catchall
 elements

During transaction processing we might have more than one catchall element:
1 live catchall element and 1 pending element that is coming as part of the
new batch.

If the map holding the catchall elements is also going away, its
required to toggle all catchall elements and not just the first viable
candidate.

Otherwise, we get:
 WARNING: ./include/net/netfilter/nf_tables.h:1281 at nft_data_release+0xb7/0xe0 [nf_tables], CPU#2: nft/1404
 RIP: 0010:nft_data_release+0xb7/0xe0 [nf_tables]
 [..]
 __nft_set_elem_destroy+0x106/0x380 [nf_tables]
 nf_tables_abort_release+0x348/0x8d0 [nf_tables]
 nf_tables_abort+0xcf2/0x3ac0 [nf_tables]
 nfnetlink_rcv_batch+0x9c9/0x20e0 [..]

Fixes: 628bd3e49cba ("netfilter: nf_tables: drop map element references from preparation phase")
Reported-by: Yiming Qian <yimingqian591@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Florian Westphal <fw@strlen.de>

diff --git a/net/netfilter/nf_tables_api.c b/net/netfilter/nf_tables_api.c
index 710f0ee21a34..dacec5f8a11c 100644
--- a/net/netfilter/nf_tables_api.c
+++ b/net/netfilter/nf_tables_api.c
@@ -829,7 +829,6 @@ static void nft_map_catchall_deactivate(const struct nft_ctx *ctx,
 
 		nft_set_elem_change_active(ctx->net, set, ext);
 		nft_setelem_data_deactivate(ctx->net, set, catchall->elem);
-		break;
 	}
 }
 
@@ -5873,7 +5872,6 @@ static void nft_map_catchall_activate(const struct nft_ctx *ctx,
 
 		nft_clear(ctx->net, ext);
 		nft_setelem_data_activate(ctx->net, set, catchall->elem);
-		break;
 	}
 }
 
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

The patch modifies `net/netfilter/nf_tables_api.c` by removing two `break;` statements inside loops in the functions `nft_map_catchall_deactivate` and `nft_map_catchall_activate`.

### Changes in Each Function

1. **`nft_map_catchall_deactivate`** (line ~829): Removed the `break;` that ended the loop after processing the first catchall element. Now the loop iterates over **all** catchall elements in the list, deactivating each one.

2. **`nft_map_catchall_activate`** (line ~5873): Removed the `break;` that ended the loop after processing the first catchall element. Now the loop iterates over **all** catchall elements in the list, activating each one.

### Relationship Between the Changes

- Both modifications are conceptually identical: they fix the same bug in two symmetric functions.
- The bug occurred when a set (map) had more than one catchall element (e.g., one currently live and one pending in the transaction batch). During transaction processing (activation or deactivation), only the first element was processed due to the `break;`, leaving other elements in an inconsistent state.
- This inconsistency caused a warning and potential use-after-free or double-free in `nft_data_release`, leading to a crash.
- By removing both `break;` statements, the code now properly handles **all** catchall elements, ensuring correct reference counting and data release when the set is being destroyed.
